title: Sequential Detonator
description: Mod for sequential detonation of TNT
body:
**What is included in version 1.0:**

- New item: Sequential Detonator with self-made 3D model.
- Interactive GUI: A convenient screen for managing the list of connected TNTs.
- Full control: The ability to change the order of explosives, remove them from the list, or instantly teleport to a selected TNT.
- Quick detonation: Detonate the next TNT in the list by pressing the button in the menu or simply left-clicking.
- Localization: Full support for English and Ukrainian languages.
